jobs.description:
helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers & designers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

New roles for Senior Designers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.

  • Direct hire: some clients hire designers full-time, and we support you through the process.

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills

  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.

  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.

  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers

  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds

  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

Who we’re looking for

Senior UI & UX Designers:

  • 5+ years of experience in UI & UX Design

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Figma & 5+ years with Prototyping, OR 5+ years of commercial experience with Figma & 3+ years with Prototyping

  • Experience with Adobe is required

  • Experience in Product design is a must

Senior Graphic Designers:

  • 5+ years of experience in Graphic Design

  • 5+ years of commercial experience with Adobe Creative Suite & Adobe Illustrator

  • Strong design craft — as a Senior Designer, you're expected to build polished, production-ready work from scratch, with a solid grasp of design systems, component architecture, and how your decisions translate into real product or brand outcomes.

  • Clear and confident communication in English — advanced ability to discuss creative briefs, defend design decisions, and flag blockers early. Strong self-presentation is essential, particularly on client calls.

  • High ownership, zero hand-holding — you thrive working full-time remotely, manage your own time, and consistently hit deadlines without being chased.

  • Reliability — we need to trust you completely. If you commit to something, you deliver it. If something changes, you communicate early.

  • Fast ramp-up — you can absorb project context quickly, align with existing style guides or brand directions, and start producing valuable work within the first days, not weeks.

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile

  2. Verify your role

  3. Once approved, we match you with a project. Typical time to first project: 3 weeks

Ready? Apply and join the community.

NOT YOUR TECH STACK?

Reach out and we'll match you.

We do not provide visa assistance, and our cooperation model does not include the benefits typically offered with direct hire.

We work with developers from 75+ countries across Europe, Latin America, North America (the U.S. and Canada), selected countries in Asia (Japan, Singapore, South Korea, the Philippines, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, and Israel), Oceania (Australia, New Zealand, and Papua New Guinea), and Africa (including Morocco and South Africa).

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Are you ready to make a real impact on people's lives and be a part of a rapidly-growing team? Natera is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help design, develop, and maintain our web portal application serving providers. As a member of our engineering team, you will play a key role in improving the user experience and functionality, ultimately helping to positively impact patient outcomes. Join us in our mission to change the way cancer is managed, and be a part of a team of dedicated professionals who are passionate about making a difference.

Senior Software Engineer - Portal Application is responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of microservices for our provider-facing web portal. The role requires working with a mix of modern and legacy technologies in a rapidly changing environment and the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and systems. Together with the talented Engineering Team, Product Managers and Designers, you will work on new and exciting experiences for our customers.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Participate in design and technical implementation decisions and help guide key stakeholders on the team, such as product managers, UI/UX designers, to ensure that design and technical decisions meet a high standard of excellence.
  • Work closely with Product Managers to gather requirements, walk through the design with stakeholders, and support software all the way from initial ideation to release, operation, and maintenance.
  • Participate in designing, building, and maintaining highly available systems to support our business applications, users, providers, and patients.
  • Perform code reviews and mentor the development team with best practices.
  • Continue improving process and procedure and evangelizing best practices.
  • Support QA activities in conjunction with our QA engineering teams.
  • Be a contributing team member to the end-to-end execution of compliance initiatives.
  • This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and have access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.
  • Must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.
  • Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • BS degree in computer science, comparable program, or equivalent.
  • 6+ years of overall software development experience, preferably secure, scalable web applications with NodeJS, TypeScript, React, and other web technologies.
  • Experience with front-end development.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle process from build, software configuration, change control, release and deployment activities.
  • Extensive knowledge and experience with Test-Driven Development and/or Domain-Driven Development Experience with service-oriented and microservice architecture.
  • Experience building, maintaining, troubleshooting, and expanding software within the AWS ecosystem: EC2, ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, S3, etc.
  • Experience with GraphQL and REST API design and event-driven architecture using distributed event stores (such as Kafka).
  • Experience with micro-service enterprise architecture, cross-platform integration, and building scalable applications in heterogeneous environments.
  • Strong relational database skills including database design and optimization.
  • Demonstrated teamwork skills with a solid analytical background.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Linux Fundamentals
  • Object Oriented Programming
  • Relational Database and SQL Programming, prefer MySQL or PostgreSQL
  • JavaScript Programming
  • Java Programming is nice to have
  • SQL and NoSQL database experience including MySQL, ElasticSearch, and DynamoDB
  • AWS Services, such as EC2, Lambdas, Step Functions, SQS, S3, and SNS
  • Build infrastructure as code with Terraform and Cloud Formation
  • Docker or container-oriented technologies
  • GraphQL and REST APIS
  • Event-Driven Microservice Architecture
  • Experience with front-end technologies such as NextJS, React, Sass, Material, HTML, CSS, Javascript, NodeJS.
  • CI / CD (Gitlab)
  • Quality Assurance Mindset
The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$125,600—$157,000 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit .

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.

Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

jobs.description:
About the COOL company

The COOL company is a global leader in AI-powered advertising technology, helping brands, agencies, and publishers simplify advertising and amplify performance.

Powered by COOL AI, our intelligent platform unifies creative generation, media activation, optimization, and attribution into one continuously learning system. Instead of relying on fragmented tools and manual campaign management, COOL AI executes thousands of real-time micro-optimizations across search, social, display, video, and connected TV—helping customers launch faster, optimize continuously, and achieve stronger business outcomes.

Our innovation and growth have earned industry-wide recognition, including being named a 7-time recipient of the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies, a 2-time Deloitte Technology Fast 500 honoree, recognized on Crain's New York Fast 50, honored by the Digiday Media Awards for helping modernize digital media, and named one of Adweek's Top 10 Fastest Growing Solution Providers globally.

We're building the future of advertising, where every signal becomes intelligence and every optimization drives performance. As we continue to grow globally, we're looking for curious, ambitious people who want to work with cutting-edge AI technology, solve complex challenges, and help redefine what's possible in modern advertising.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-Senior Full-Stack Engineer to join our Product Engineering team, reporting to the Engineering Manager (Bi Yoo). This role is responsible for building and maintaining the web applications that power our advertising platform, including the Cool AI campaign management system, billing and invoicing module, and advertiser-facing dashboards. The Full-Stack Engineer will work across our frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Java/Spring Boot) stack, delivering features end-to-end from database schema design through API development to polished UI implementation.

Challenges and Opportunities

This role spans the full product surface of a growing ad tech platform. You'll build features that advertisers interact with daily — campaign creation and launch workflows, real-time performance dashboards, multi-platform account

integrations (Google Ads, Meta, Adform), and automated billing systems. There is significant opportunity to shape product architecture as we scale to support new advertising channels, expand our AI-driven campaign optimization, and

onboard enterprise clients with complex billing and permissions requirements.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design and implement full-stack features across React (TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite) and Spring Boot (Java 17, PostgreSQL) codebases

  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs with proper authentication, authorization (role-based access control), and input validation

  • Design and evolve PostgreSQL database schemas using Flyway migrations, including JSONB modeling for flexible domain objects

  • Develop responsive, accessible UI components following existing design patterns and component libraries

  • Integrate with third-party advertising platform APIs (Google Ads, Meta Marketing API, Adform) for account management and data synchronization

  • Implement and maintain OAuth flows for external platform connections

  • Build complex business logic including billing calculations, invoice generation, and payment processing workflows

  • Write efficient database queries and optimize application performance for large datasets

  • Collaborate with the data engineering team on Snowflake integrations for analytics and reporting features

  • Participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and maintaining code quality standards

  • Troubleshoot production issues across the full stack using AWS CloudWatch logs and application monitoring

  • Contribute to CI/CD pipeline maintenance and deployment processes

Qualifications

Professional Competencies

  • 4-6 years of professional software engineering experience in full-stack web development

  • Strong proficiency in Java (11+) and Spring Boot, including Spring Security, Spring Data JPA, and RESTful API design

  • Strong proficiency in React (16+) with TypeScript, including hooks, state management, and modern component patterns

  • Solid experience with PostgreSQL including schema design, query optimization, indexing strategies, and migrations

  • Experience with CSS frameworks (Tailwind CSS preferred) and building responsive layouts

  • Familiarity with cloud services, particularly AWS (S3, SES, Lambda, ECS, CloudWatch)

  • Experience integrating with third-party REST APIs and OAuth 2.0 authentication flows

  • Understanding of Git workflows, pull request processes, and collaborative development practices

  • Ability to independently own features from technical design through deployment

  • Strong debugging skills across frontend and backend, including browser DevTools and server-side logging

Cultural Competencies

  • Must be able to work primarily between the hours of 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM ET

  • Must have a player/coach mentality, willing to both execute and lead

  • Ability to juggle multiple projects concurrently and set and meet deadlines

  • Skilled at receiving and providing direct feedback

  • Collaborative mindset and great teamwork skills

  • Entrepreneurial & adaptable; great learning skills

  • Curious, research-minded, data-informed

  • Able to search for possible solutions and apply them

  • Creative confidence

  • Proactive communicator

  • A sense of humor and a love of online culture

  • Thrives in a start-up culture

Job Title: Looking for Full Stack Software Engineer

Job Location: Ohio City, OH 45874, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Flexible

Job Seniority Level:

About the Role

We are looking for a talented and experienced Full Stack Software Engineer to join our growing development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable web applications across both frontend and backend systems.

The ideal candidate has strong experience with modern JavaScript frameworks, backend development, RESTful APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure. You should be comfortable working independently, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and contributing to technical decisions throughout the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications using React, TypeScript, and Node.js.

  • Build responsive, user-friendly interfaces with a strong focus on performance and usability.

  • Develop secure and efficient RESTful APIs and backend services.

  • Design and optimize relational and NoSQL databases.

  • Integrate third-party APIs and external services.

  • Implement authentication, authorization, and application security best practices.

  • Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues and optimize application performance.

  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and technical planning.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver high-quality software.

  • Support application deployment, monitoring, and maintenance.

  • Contribute to CI/CD workflows and cloud infrastructure improvements.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience.

  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.

  • Solid hands-on experience with React.js and Node.js.

  • Experience developing RESTful APIs and integrating backend services.

  • Strong understanding of HTML5, CSS3, and responsive web design.

  • Experience working with PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB.

  • Familiarity with Git, automated testing, and modern development workflows.

  • Understanding of software architecture, security, and performance optimization.

  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to communicate effectively and work collaboratively in a remote team environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Next.js, NestJS, or Python.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized deployments.

  • Knowledge of GraphQL, Redis, or microservices architecture.

  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools.

  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum development methodologies.

  • Experience integrating AI-powered features or third-party AI APIs.

What We're Looking For

We value engineers who take ownership of their work, communicate clearly, and enjoy solving complex technical challenges. You should be comfortable contributing across the full application stack and working with a distributed team.

If you're passionate about building reliable, scalable software and enjoy working with modern technologies, we'd love to hear from you.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume along with links to your GitHub profile, portfolio, or relevant projects, if available.

We look forward to learning more about your experience.
